name: palaia
description: Connects Claude Desktop to your palaia memory hub.
long_description: palaia-proxy is a thin bridge: it speaks stdio MCP to Claude Desktop on one side and streamable HTTP to your self-hosted palaia hub on the other, so every tool your hub exposes shows up here exactly as it does in any other client. Nothing runs locally beyond this bridge — your notes stay on your own hub.

hub_url.title: Hub address
hub_url.description: The web address of your palaia hub's tool profile, e.g. https://hub.example.com/mcp/default/.

token.title: Access token
token.description: Leave this blank if your hub uses sign-in instead of a token.

oauth.title: Sign in instead of using a token
oauth.description: Turn this on if your hub asked you to sign in rather than giving you a token.

issuer.title: Sign-in address
issuer.description: Only needed when 'Sign in instead of using a token' is on.

profile.title: Tool profile
profile.description: Which set of tools this connection should see. Leave as 'default' unless your hub told you otherwise.
